name: Wasion Holdings Limited
summary: Wasion Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the research and development, production, and sale of energy metering and energy efficiency management solutions for energy supply industries. The company operates through three segments: Smart grid solutions, AI-integrated energy efficiency solutions, and Digital energy services. Its Smart grid solutions segment offers power metering infrastructure to provides full-stack intelligent solutions for power grid planning, operation, monitoring, maintenance, and optimization by leveraging intelligence technologies, such as artificial intelligence and machine learning.
